records.title: San Pietro Celestino
records.sourceNotes: Early 17th-century oil canvas in L'Aquila, 130×100cm; Celestine V in pontifical attire carrying book and city model. Catalogue classifies school, suggests possible hand of master; painting in poor condition and needs source-color QA.

records.title: Vision of Saint Angela Merici
records.sourceNotes: 1931 oil canvas in Verona, Pegrassi (1900–1957). Unlike centuries-old work, original painting may remain copyright-protected; do not infer reuse permission. Contemporary design draws on Caravaggio but must not label it a Baroque-era picture.

records.title: Queen St Margaret of Scotland
records.sourceNotes: Sizergh Castle NT998409; c.1692 oil on canvas, signed, 135×103cm. National Trust / Robert Thrift photo credits and image-order service; keep exact artistic identity while holding selected photograph.

records.title: Ritratto di San Gregorio Barbarigo
records.sourceNotes: Bergamo Palazzo Frizzoni, oil on canvas c.1780–before1796. Scholarly attribution revised from Giuseppe Antonio Orelli to Vincenzo Angelo Orelli. Catalogue directs high-res photo requests to custodians; no free image permission inferred.

records.title: San Lorenzo Giustiniani distribuisce l'elemosina ai poveri
records.sourceNotes: Venice 1691 oil on canvas, huge 600×1020cm horizontal composition with poor and clergy; potentially hard to crop at 390px without losing saint, test full-image rendering.

records.title: Ritratto di San Lorenzo Giustiniani
records.sourceNotes: Oil on canvas c.1608–1610 at Pinacoteca Ambrosiana, Milan; a different work from Lazzarini charity scene. Exact Ambrosiana selected photo/licence pending.

records.title: Saint Thomas de Villeneuve faisant l'aumône
records.sourceNotes: 17th-century oil on canvas, 160×86.5cm, Louvre INV20459, currently not on view. Museum explicitly lists 'Maratti, Carlo, D'après'; do not credit autograph Maratti or assume official image commercial reuse.

records.title: St Wenceslas Hoeing a Vineyard, Pressing Wine and Baking Hosts
records.sourceNotes: 1641–43 cycle: 32 original works, 8 extant; the specific 10th large-format oil canvas survives in PRIVATE ownership, displayed in 2024 exhibition. No acquisition/photo licence established; don't conflate with separate museum-held anti-idol scene.

records.title: San Giovanni Leonardi
records.sourceNotes: Original proposed accession 0900053335 could not be retrieved or independently indexed during this pass. Alternative exact saint painting: Marcello Sozzi, San Giovanni Leonardi in gloria, ICCD 1200232012; DISTINCT work not a silent replacement. Previous exact-oil classification remains provisional until key 0900053335 can be confirmed.

records.title: Cud św. Jana Kantego / The Miracle of Saint John Cantius
records.sourceNotes: c.1767, oil on canvas 135×98.5cm, museum MNK II-a-448; saint miraculously repairs a broken milk jug for a poor girl. Source says copyright class Public Domain; exact downloadable image file, rights and SHA still unverified.

records.title: San Antonio María Claret
records.sourceNotes: Andalusian IAPH item 67609, oil portrait of seated bishop. Repository mentions public usage with credit 'Fondo Gráfico del IAPH' but 'No hay ficheros asociados a este ítem'; cannot promote selected image without bytes and exact rights check. Do not conflate with separate 334291 portrait under noncommercial licence.

records.title: Madonna with St John the Evangelist and St Gregory Thaumaturgus
records.sourceNotes: 1629–30 oil altarpiece in Modena; artist payment entered 25 June 1630, installed for St Gregory's Nov 17 feast. Exact Gregory Thaumaturgus with Virgin and St John, but only photograph rights unresolved.

records.title: San Felice di Valois
records.artist: Workshop of Paolo Amedeo Botta, possibly relative/successor
records.sourceNotes: 1796 oil canvas in Demonte, 100×76cm, with angel and cherubs. Catalogue links a Botta workshop but 1796 is decades after the documented Paolo Amedeo Botta activity (1718–45); possibly son/brother. Do not assert a personally executed 1796 original by him.

records.title: San Benedetto dà la regola a san Silvestro abate
records.sourceNotes: c.1700–1724 oil canvas 195×130cm at Santo Stefano del Cacco, Rome; St Benedict presents his Rule to Sylvester. Separate from 1870 frescoes in same church; owner state.

records.title: San Silvestro Abate
records.artist: Central Italian school, unidentified GLD-monogram artist
records.sourceNotes: 1714–24 oil canvas 300×150cm in Osimo; abbot in liturgical vestments, niche, crosier/mitre; unsigned attribution not certain despite GLD monogram. Distinct composition from St Benedict handing him rule.
